name: ml-payroll-social
description: Mali payroll and social-contribution research draft for 2026, using older DGI provisions, the 2010 AMO decrees and undated government guidance without certifying their complete current amendment chain. Use it to build conditional employer workpapers for branch-by-branch INPS contributions, private-sector AMO, contribution bases, headcount-dependent payment calendars, employer payroll taxes and wage-withholding controls. It distinguishes the housing tax, professional-training tax, youth-employment tax and ANPE levy, which the former Guide mixed together. It links the wage-income Guide for ITS bands rather than copying them. Two executable examples test contribution splits and the payment-calendar decision. Current legal continuity, wage floors, risk classification, declaration forms and portal procedures remain held for verification.
